shortDefinition.en: Metadata fields that can describe a file's settings, timestamps, equipment, and other information.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 可描述文件设置、时间、器材和其他信息的元数据字段。

en: EXIF can be missing or edited; it is not proof of every shooting condition or original-file availability.
zh-cn: EXIF 可能缺失或被编辑，不能证明全部拍摄条件或原始文件可用。

example.en: A gallery caption may show focal length and ISO without offering an original downloadable file.
example.zh-cn: 画廊说明可以展示焦距和 ISO，但不提供原始文件下载。

sources.title: Metadata basics and actions — Adobe Lightroom Classic
sources.supports: Metadata inspection, editing, and privacy considerations.
